text: The Monster in the Frozen City
Defeat Baphomela, the monster that has froze Navida\nCity!
Collect Burning Liquid to save the Xmas Knights\nfrom the ice!
Collect Burning Liquid at Fiery Volcano and deliver\nit to Agios with the caravan members!
Melt the ice with the Burning Liquid and rescue the Xmas\nKnights in the ice!
